name: Finite Volume Method (FVM)
summary: Discretize integral conservation laws through flux balance on control volumes.
summary_zh: 在控制体上积分守恒方程，通过界面通量构造离散守恒关系。
core_idea: Integrate each conservation law over cells and balance numerical face fluxes.
innovation: Offers natural local conservation control for advection, flow and hemodynamic PDEs.
limitations: Flux design and mesh quality affect accuracy.
Different schemes may require limiting and nonlinear stabilization.

start_here.why: Canonical text for conservative finite-volume discretization and flux reasoning.
start_here.focus: Integral form, Riemann fluxes, stability of hyperbolic problems.
